description: Returns public steamwebapi pricing plans, per-endpoint rate limits, API-key location, quota guidance and a recommended plan for the requested use case. Does not perform checkout or account actions.

creditsPerRequest.description: Credit cost of one call when options or batch size change the base cost. Consult the endpoint documentation.

endpointPath.description: Documented route path without a query or credentials, e.g. "/steam/api/item", "/steam/api/items" or "/market/{market}/prices". Prefer this over guessing a limit from the use case.

expectedRequestsPerDay.description: Expected peak requests per day. When monthly demand is omitted, this is projected over 31 days.

expectedRequestsPerMinute.description: Expected peak requests in one minute.

expectedRequestsPerMonth.description: Expected total requests per monthly billing period. Supply this when traffic is not recurring daily.

includePlanCatalog.description: Include the full public plan catalog with prices and rate limits. Defaults to true.

useCase.description: Optional use case such as "inventory", "profile", "float", "history", "items", "market prices" or "balanced production app".

name: get_pricing
title: Get steamwebapi pricing and quota guidance
